general.estado_no_disponible_detalle: This request cannot be registered now. Return to the list and try again later.
general.necesidad_ayuda: State what your centre needs, for how long and for how many hours each week. For a vacancy or replacement, find the published post. Its code does not prove that it is vacant. Temporary Staff Selection will decide the appointment type later.
general.error_numero_personas: Enter a whole number of people between 1 and 4,294,967,295.
general.jornada_formato: Enter 37:30 or 37.5 for 37 hours and 30 minutes.
general.puesto_busqueda: Post code in the published RPT
general.puesto_sin_seleccion: Find and select the published post.
general.puesto_no_encontrado: This post is not in the published RPT. Check the code and search again.
general.puesto_consulta_error: The RPT could not be checked. Select Find post to try again.
general.puesto_publicacion_pendiente: The post is listed, but its publication details are unavailable. Try again later before submitting the request.
general.error_puesto_publicacion: Select a post from the published RPT before reviewing the request.
general.titular_ref: Reference of the employee being replaced (optional)
general.error_porcentaje_financiacion: Enter a whole percentage from 1 to 100.
general.error_codigo_necesidad: Enter a code of up to 80 characters, without spaces or accents.
general.error_justificacion_temporal: Explain the temporary workload in up to 4,000 characters, without spaces at the start or end.
general.error_numero_moad_formato: Use the format shown in the MOAD case number example.
general.estado_numero_moad_no_valido: The MOAD case number does not match the published format. Return to edit it.
general.estado_catalogo_numero_pendiente: The current catalogue will be checked before you review the corrected number.
general.estado_catalogo_numero_cargando: Checking the current catalogue. Keep this page open.
general.estado_catalogo_numero_error: The current catalogue could not be checked. Your details remain here; review the request again.
general.error_catalogo_no_actualizado: Review again when the current catalogue can be checked.
general.estado_error: The request could not be confirmed. Check the details and try again.
general.error_jornada: Enter whole hours and minutes, from 1 minute to 168 hours.
general.error_uno_de: Enter only one of the funding references.
general.error_periodo_maximo_necesidad: The period exceeds the limit for this need. Check the end date.
